rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a human or animal body, including the fleshly body contrasted with the soul and the torso in contexts such as boxing.

example.english: Exercise can make the body healthier.
example.traditional: 做運動可以令身體更加健康。
example.jyutping: zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 ling6 san1 tai2 gang3 gaa1 gin6 hong1

rows.note: Use this specifically when body means a dead person or animal.

example.english: The police found a body at the scene.
example.traditional: 警方喺現場發現一具屍體。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 jat1 geoi6 si1 tai2

rows.note: Use this for an official, institutional, or organizational body rather than a loose group of people.

example.english: This official body specializes in helping grassroots families.
example.traditional: 呢個機構專門幫助基層家庭。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gei1 kau3 zyun1 mun4 bong1 zo6 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4

rows.note: Use this for the main text of a letter, message, or document, excluding its heading, greeting, or signature.

example.english: The body of this letter is written very clearly.
example.traditional: 呢封信嘅內文寫得好清楚。
example.jyutping: ni1 fung1 seon3 ge3 noi6 man4 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2
